name: Anikku Harmony Preview v0.2.0-harmony-preview.40
body:
## 本次变更

- 轻玻璃与柔和边缘：去掉两道闭合描边与整圈提亮，改用局部柔反射，减少线圈和金属边框感。
- 胶囊背景模糊从10降到7dp，保留通透内容和实心字对比；字号略缩小至13.5sp，文字衬影更收敛。
- 按压光晕中心更亮、近圈更清楚，远处继续柔淡；宽范围与短点按、慢淡出时序保留。

更新后请看：静止时是否不再有整圈亮线；深浅色和封面经过时的通透感、字迹与字号；按住及短点按的中心亮度和淡出。
基于 [Anikku v0.2.0](https://github.com/komikku-app/anikku/releases/tag/v0.2.0) 的非官方 HarmonyOS / 卓易通 兼容构建 (preview 构建类型)。

- `0003-updater-use-harmony-fork-releases.patch`: updater: check this fork's GitHub releases for -harmony-preview builds
- `0004-storage-app-private-location-option.patch`: storage: offer the app-private directory as a one-tap storage location
- `0005-build-flexible-adapter-from-maven-central.patch`: build: resolve FlexibleAdapter from Maven Central instead of JitPack
- `0006-downloads-hide-videos-from-gallery-with-unknown-extension.patch`: downloads: hide videos from gallery apps with an unknown file extension
- `0007-downloads-share-downloads-across-entries-by-url.patch`: downloads: reuse a download held by another entry with the same url
- `0008-updater-in-screen-download-progress-and-install.patch`: updater: keep the update screen open with progress and an Install button

- `0010-downloads-notification-speed-and-progress.patch`: downloads: Animeko-style progress notification with speed and progress
- `0011-updater-no-background-auto-download-and-apk-cleanup.patch`: updater: keep the background auto-download from blocking the update screen

- `0014-updater-release-mirror.patch`: updater: read the release list from the repo-branch mirror first

- `0016-downloads-finalize-with-fewer-saf-copies-and-error-reasons.patch`: downloads: finish videos with fewer SAF copies and show why a download failed
- `0017-updater-stable-release-notes-while-downloading.patch`: updater: keep the release notes stable while downloading; tidy ffmpeg failure text
- `0018-downloads-never-skip-silently-reuse-or-replace-leftover-folders.patch`: downloads: never drop an episode silently; reuse or replace folders left on disk
- `0019-crash-log-filter-harmony-noise-and-keep-app-log.patch`: =?UTF-8?q?crash=20log:=20filter=20=E5=8D=93=E6=98=93?= =?UTF-8?q?=E9=80=9A=20graphics=20noise=20and=20keep=20the=20app's=20own?= =?UTF-8?q?=20log=20lines?=

- `0021-browse-panorama-grids-staggered-and-wider-auto-columns.patch`: browse: panorama comfortable grids flow as staggered grids with wider auto columns
- `0022-library-panorama-compact-grid-display-mode.patch`: library: add a panorama compact grid display mode
- `0023-presentation-staggered-fast-scroller-steady-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast scroller thumb steady
- `0024-updater-pick-highest-harmony-version.patch`: updater: pick the highest harmony version instead of the first listed
- `0025-library-panorama-stable-cell-shapes.patch`: library: keep panorama cell shapes stable while scrolling
- `0026-presentation-cover-asyncimage-smooth-grids.patch`: presentation: draw covers with AsyncImage so grids scroll without subcomposition
- `0027-library-panorama-settle-debounce-browse-prefetch.patch`: library: wait for the panorama grid to really stop and learn browse shapes ahead
- `0028-presentation-staggered-scroller-stable-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast-scroll thumb from stepping back once a row
- `0029-download-quality-separate-from-playback.patch`: download: pick the download quality separately from playback
- `0030-presentation-panorama-masonry-reading-order.patch`: presentation: lay panorama cells left to right unless a lane is recessed by half
- `0031-presentation-panorama-auto-columns-span.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns fit book covers and wide covers span two lanes
- `0032-presentation-panorama-scroll-anchor-by-key.patch`: presentation: panorama grid saves its scroll anchor by key
- `0033-presentation-panorama-layout-epoch.patch`: presentation: panorama layout skips per-item work while content is unchanged
- `0034-library-panorama-cover-shapes-versioned.patch`: library: panorama cover shapes notify per version, not per map read
- `0035-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller thumb stays grabbed while pressed
- `0036-presentation-panorama-tiered-auto-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns widen on large windows
- `0037-presentation-fast-scroller-snapshotflow.patch`: presentation: fast scroller follows scroll without restarting per frame
- `0038-presentation-panorama-shaped-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns follow the shelf's dominant cover shape
- `0039-library-panorama-shape-mode.patch`: library: panorama grids pick tall or wide columns from committed cover shapes
- `0040-presentation-fast-scroller-thumb-hitbox.patch`: presentation: fast scroller hit box stays on the drawn thumb
- `0041-presentation-panorama-scroll-trace.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll trace in the crash log dump
- `0042-presentation-panorama-exact-scroll-delta.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll reports the exact delta it applied
- `0043-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-to-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller grabs on the thumb or on a hold beside it
- `0044-app-scroll-performance-recorder.patch`: app: scroll performance recorder with a share button
- `0045-browse-panorama-refresh-paging-snapshot.patch`: browse: refresh panorama intervals when paging changes
- `0046-presentation-panorama-readable-auto-columns.patch`: presentation: size panorama columns by readable cover width
- `0047-presentation-unify-panorama-surfaces.patch`: presentation: share panorama policy across library browse and related grids
- `0048-presentation-compact-scroll-navigation.patch`: presentation: use compact navigation and reveal it on reverse scrolling
- `0049-presentation-immersive-browsing-chrome.patch`: presentation: collapse complete browsing headers and reveal navigation immediately
- `0050-presentation-synchronized-floating-navigation.patch`: presentation: synchronize floating navigation without moving browsing content
- `0051-presentation-gesture-latched-navigation.patch`: presentation: stabilize navigation gestures and keep scrollers inside safe tracks
- `0052-presentation-glass-navigation-polish.patch`: presentation: polish compact glass navigation and scroll geometry
- `0053-presentation-inline-tabs-refresh-layer.patch`: presentation: refine inline navigation and translucent edge browsing
- `0054-ui-refresh-window-insets.patch`: ui: refresh edge-to-edge insets after window changes
- `0055-presentation-reveal-navigation-at-end.patch`: presentation: reveal floating navigation at the list end
- `0056-presentation-preserve-navigation-scroll-source.patch`: presentation: preserve navigation scroll source and single-line badges
- `0057-ui-history-cards-and-pinned-more-glass.patch`: ui: show dated history cards and pin glass navigation on More
- `0058-updater-refresh-manual-checks.patch`: updater: fetch fresh release metadata for manual checks
- `0059-ui-lazy-timelines-and-window-state.patch`: ui: virtualize history and updates and preserve fold navigation state
- `0060-ui-timeline-preference-wiring.patch`: ui: connect legacy panorama switches to timeline display mode
- `0061-ui-anikku-timeline-column-baseline.patch`: ui: use Anikku column baseline for timeline cards
- `0062-ui-timeline-panorama-and-clock.patch`: ui: align timeline panorama spans and compact 24-hour actions
- `0063-ui-browsing-side-insets-and-tabs.patch`: ui: remove browsing cutout gutter and animate category indicator
- `0064-ui-floating-capsule-and-fast-swipes.patch`: ui: float glass navigation and stabilize repeated fast upward swipes
- `0065-test-capsule-badge-semantics.patch`: test: locate capsule badge in unmerged semantics tree
- `0066-ui-text-glass-and-bidirectional-fast-swipes.patch`: ui: rebuild text-only refractive glass navigation and hide on fast return swipes
- `0067-ui-glass-renderer-compatibility.patch`: fix: support legacy shader sampling and clear completed fling speed
- `0068-ui-neutral-glass-text-and-render-test.patch`: ui: keep glass text neutral and enable native kernel pixel validation
- `0069-ui-glass-array-uniforms.patch`: fix: bind glass shader dimensions through array uniforms
- `0070-ui-capsule-type-spacing-and-gesture-sensitivity.patch`: fix(ui): soften navigation hiding and use solid compact capsule labels
- `0071-ui-capsule-fit-optics-and-touch.patch`: fix(ui): fit capsule corners and own its full touch surface
- `0072-ui-capsule-drag-count.patch`: test(ui): count the initial capsule tap before drag assertions
- `0073-ui-stop-hidden-glass-capture.patch`: perf(ui): stop glass backdrop capture while navigation is fully hidden
- `0074-ui-capsule-feedback-symmetry-and-legibility.patch`: fix(ui): balance capsule touch feedback symmetry and legibility
- `0075-ui-soft-glass-edges-and-brighter-contact.patch`: fix(ui): soften glass edges and brighten the touch core

## 安装说明

- 下载 `Anikku-v0.2.0-harmony-preview.40-arm64-v8a.apk`（华为设备均为 arm64）。
- 包名为 `app.anikku.beta`，与官方 Anikku Preview 相同，但签名不同：**第一次安装前必须先卸载官方 Preview**。卸载前先在 设置 → 数据与存储 → 创建备份 导出备份，装好后再恢复；下载目录里已下载的视频不会丢，重新选择同一个存储位置即可。
- harmony-preview 版本之间可直接覆盖安装；应用内更新会检查本仓库的 Release，而不是官方更新服务器。
- 继续使用 Documents/Anikku 这类自选文件夹即可：本构建已把 ffmpeg 输出改到应用私有缓存再复制过去，并在目录重命名失败时自动改为复制。
- 鸿蒙图库：设置 → 下载 → 「下载的视频对系统图库隐藏」默认开启，新下载存成 `<集>.mkv.anikku`（鸿蒙不认 .nomedia、只看扩展名）。升级前已下载的视频点同一页的「按上述设置重命名已下载的视频」补上后缀（下载进行中时先暂停）。
- 同一视频收藏进多个文件夹（如 XvXun）：设置 → 下载 → 「不同条目间共用已下载的视频」默认开启，任一条目下载过的视频在其他条目里也显示为已下载并直接播放；删除请到实际下载它的条目里操作。
- 不想在文件管理里看到任何下载内容，可改用 设置 → 数据与存储 → 「使用应用私有目录（鸿蒙推荐）」；代价是卸载应用时会一并删除。

body:
## 本次变更

- 三边等距玻璃胶囊：纠正左右与底部的留白关系，底边稍贴近手势条，左右下角参考系统屏幕圆角形成内侧轮廓。
